status: Retired at explicit user instruction; never a generic method

protocol.reason: Endpoint evidence and three-state separation misrank rescuable HC cases. Use the existing head specifically trained for per-frame event membership, not an invented event proxy.
protocol.head: Original model_ema action_embed MLP(256,256,1,2), eval, last native temporal hidden; CPU only. No training or decoder/encoder/expert call.
protocol.loss_calibration: Official vidstg/hcstvg2 experiments EOS_COEF=.3; negative-weighted BCE has logit_eta=logit_weighted+log(.3) at population optimum. Raw controls retained. Checkpoints omit training cfg, so this is a configuration-based correction, not proof of exact calibration.
protocol.likelihood: Physical-cell-weighted whole-video Bernoulli event-membership likelihood for each same13 candidate, including outside-event terms. ActionJoint weights frames by max(ROI visual-attention enrichment/(1-area),0), not by an event pseudo-label.
protocol.prior: Candidate must improve likelihood over incumbent and lose at most one incumbent posterior IoU SD in native expected IoU. No scalar mixing weight. Unconstrained controls remove this guard.
protocol.matched: ActionOnly shares all hidden and candidate info; ActionPermuted changes only area-matched spatial placement; raw logits isolate loss-offset assumption; prior/random matched intervene on exactly ActionJoint queries.
protocol.candidate: Same12 per-layer/offset MBR plus Global6; all old Source/Baseline/candidates unchanged.
protocol.budget: One fixed head-based structural trial, no temperature/threshold/weight sweep; one CPU thread/nice15. 256 frozen small-head calls, no CUDA or new heavy network.
protocol.adoption: HC64 ActionJoint t/fullv/fixedv positive, better t than ActionOnly and ActionPermuted, Source-relative severe v <=baseline+2; both32 rechecks t>0 and fullv>=0, pooled t lower95>0/fullv lower95>-.5pp. Temporal-only ActionOnly assessed separately, never mislabeled joint contribution.
protocol.exposure: HC64 failures used for design; all cohorts historically exposed. New predictions seal before independent new GT scores. No per-query GT gating.
